title: "Portfolio Piece 3"
output: html_document
---

In this portfolio piece, R will be used to create a hierarchial figure of trial types. 

```{r study1_trial_types_figure}
library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph G {
rankdir=TB; //top-to-bottom 
nodesep=1; 
ranksep=1.2; 
node [shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = white, fontname = TimesNewRoman, width=.5, fixedsize=FALSE] 

// Level 1 
{rank=same;
A1 [label = 'Study 1 Trial Types'];
}

// Level 2
{rank=same; 
B1 [label = 'Image 1 Maintain Physical Properties'];
B2 [label = 'Image 1 Maintain Emotional Feelings']
}

// Level 3
{rank=same;
C1 [label = 'Image 2 Focus Physical Properties'];
C2 [label = 'Image 2 Focus Emotional Feelings'];
C3 [label = 'Image 2 Focus Physical Properties'];
C4 [label = 'Image 2 Focus Emotional Feelings'];
}

// Level 4 
{rank = same; 
D1 [label = 'Negative'];
D2 [label = 'Positive'];
D3 [label = 'Negative'];
D4 [label = 'Positive'];
D5 [label = 'Negative'];
D6 [label = 'Positive'];
D7 [label = 'Negative'];
D8 [label = 'Positive'];
}


// Invisible edges 
B1 -> B2 [style=invis]; 
C1 -> C2 [style=invis]; 
C3 -> C4 [style=invis]; 
D1 -> D2 [style=invis]; 
D3 -> D4 [style=invis]; 
D5 -> D6 [style=invis]; 
D7 -> D8 [style=invis]; 

A1 -> B1;
A1 -> B2; 
B1 -> C1;
B1 -> C2;
B2 -> C3; 
B2 -> C4; 
C1 -> D1; 
C1 -> D2
C2 -> D3;
C2 -> D4; 
C3 -> D5; 
C3 -> D6; 
C4 -> D7; 
C4 -> D8
}
")

```
